title: Extending pkg/infra: multi-file cochange requirements
answers: What do I need to update when adding a new metric?
What files change when adding a new background service?
How do I add a new serverlock query?
Why do wire bindings need updating in three places?
body:
- New Prometheus metric: declare the var in `pkg/infra/metrics/metrics.go`, init it in `init()`, AND add it to the `MustRegister(...)` list in `initMetricVars` — skipping the third step means the metric is silently never exposed.
- New `BackgroundService`: implement `registry.BackgroundService.Run`, thread the service through `pkg/registry/backgroundsvcs/background_services.go:ProvideBackgroundServiceRegistry`'s constructor, register the provider in `pkg/server/wire_core.go`, then run `make gen-go` to regenerate `wire_gen.go`.
- New `serverlock` SQL template: add a `.sql` file under `pkg/infra/serverlock/queries/`, add a matching `mustTemplate(...)` var in `pkg/infra/serverlock/templates.go`, and add per-dialect golden files under `pkg/infra/serverlock/testdata/{mysql,postgres,sqlite}--<template>-<name>.sql` — checked by `pkg/infra/serverlock/templates_test.go:TestTemplates`.
- Wire binds for infra interfaces (`db.DB`, `tracing.Tracer`, `leaderelection.Elector`) are triplicated across `wireSet`, `wireCLISet`, and `wireTestSet` in `pkg/server/wire_core.go` — e.g. `leaderelection.Elector` binds to a real k8s-lease elector in the main set but to `DefaultElector` in the CLI/test sets. Updating only one set gives one build mode the wrong implementation.
applies: Applies when adding a new Prometheus metric, a new BackgroundService, a new serverlock SQL query, or a new interface bound via wire in pkg/infra. Does not apply to plain internal refactors of existing infra code.
